units.one_line: Connects the ciphernode to its EVM contracts: decodes chain logs into bus events and submits the node's transactions.

actors.name: EvmReadInterface
actors.role: Reads logs for every routed contract address: historical sync from the start block, then a live subscription with backfill and reconnect.

actors.name: EvmRouter
actors.role: Sends each log to the parser for its emitting address; a log with no route goes to the fallback as rejected.

actors.name: InterfoldSolReader
actors.role: Interfold.sol: decodes IInterfold events through a version-aware EvmParser.

actors.name: CiphernodeRegistrySolReader
actors.role: CiphernodeRegistry.sol: decodes committee, ticket, and public-key chunk events.

actors.name: BondingRegistrySolReader
actors.role: BondingRegistry.sol: decodes ticket and bond balance, operator activation, and admission events.

actors.name: RandomnessProviderSolReader
actors.role: RandomnessProvider: decodes RandomnessFulfilled, waits until the registry accepts the sortition seed (sortitionSeed), then emits a committee request.

actors.name: EvmParser
actors.role: Applies a per-contract extractor to each log; a strict extractor turns an undecodable log at a routed address into a rejection, which fails the gateway closed.

actors.name: FixHistoricalOrder
actors.role: Holds a HistoricalSyncComplete marker back until the event it refers to has been observed.

actors.name: EvmChainGateway
actors.role: Buffers events until the sync actor starts, hands the historical batch over, then forwards live events to the bus; fails closed on error.

actors.name: DataAvailabilityCoordinator
actors.role: Assembles committee-key chunks from chain events and retrieves ciphertext outputs through e3-data-availability.

actors.name: CiphernodeRegistrySolWriter
actors.role: Writes to CiphernodeRegistry.sol: submitTicket, finalizeCommittee, publishCommittee, and publishCommitteePublicKey chunks; acts only on a local PublicKeyAggregated.

actors.name: InterfoldSolWriter
actors.role: Writes to Interfold.sol: publishPlaintextOutput for a local PlaintextAggregated, plus markE3Failed and processE3Failure around failure deadlines.

actors.name: SlashingManagerSolWriter
actors.role: Writes to SlashingManager.sol: proposeSlash or proposeSlashByDkgParty after AccusationQuorumReached; with the policy disabled it publishes a local exclusion instead.

emits.name: HistoricalEvmEventsReceived (buffered history to the sync actor)
committee request (after RandomnessFulfilled and registry acceptance)
tx publishCommitteePublicKey(chunk), one call per chunk
tx markE3Failed or processE3Failure (failure deadline and settlement)
tx proposeSlash(e3Id, operator, proof) or proposeSlashByDkgParty

state.name: Slashing writer recovery state, per chain
Data-availability recovery state: key chunks, pending outputs, terminal E3s
Ingestion heartbeat file per chain (health check only, not a resume cursor)
Reader watermark last_block (memory only; a restart replays from the snapshot block cursor)

key_types.name: InterfoldEvmEvent
key_types.what: the message between ingestion stages: Log, Event, Rejected, Processed, HistoricalSyncComplete

key_types.name: EvmLog
key_types.what: raw provider log tagged with its chain id and block timestamp

key_types.name: Filters
key_types.what: start block, confirmations, and the widest eth_getLogs window for one chain reader

key_types.name: IInterfold
key_types.what: alloy sol! binding for Interfold.sol; the other contracts have their own sol! blocks in contracts.rs

key_types.name: ensure_node_release
key_types.what: startup check: verifies this binary and acknowledges it on INodeReleaseRegistry before the readers start

key_types.name: ProviderCache
key_types.what: cached RPC providers and signer, with read-only and write-enabled startup states

key_types.name: EvmSystemChainBuilder
key_types.what: registers one chain's contract routes and starts its ingestion gateway

read_first.why: crate purpose and the reader/writer split
historical catch-up, then the live loop with reconnect
the reader's start block comes from the routing table and the chain's deploy block
restart: the block cursor saved with the snapshot replaces the deploy block

rust_patterns.note: EvmRouter is a plain actix actor that owns its routing table
a failed publication is retried after a fixed delay with run_later
the provider is taken once when the reader starts; a second start bails out
the gateway matches each InterfoldEvmEvent variant and fails closed on the ones it must not receive

units.tests: cargo test -p e3-evm. Unit tests sit in src/ and in the *tests.rs modules. crates/evm/tests/live_sepolia_window.rs is #[ignore] and needs network access and the live Sepolia deployment.
unverified: Whether events at the snapshot block are deduplicated on replay was not traced; collect_history.rs:47-58 dedups per chain, not per event.
Whether the on-chain CommitteePublished event and the DA-assembled CommitteePublished can both reach the bus for one E3 was not traced.

units.one_line: Content-addressed object transport: publishes bytes to Avail and retrieves them by hash, re-hashing what it reads.

state.name: Object bytes (at most 1 MiB) carried by Avail submit_data extrinsics

key_types.name: DataReference
key_types.what: content hash, Avail block number, and leaf index that Ethereum records for one object

key_types.name: PendingPublication
key_types.what: Avail block hash, block number, and extrinsic index needed to request a bridge proof

key_types.name: ProofStatus
key_types.what: Pending, or Ready with the ABI-encoded Merkle proof and the reference

key_types.name: VectorXBridgeApi
key_types.what: HTTP client for the official Avail VectorX bridge proof route

key_types.name: AvailPublisher
key_types.what: signs submit_data, waits for finality, and returns the coordinates needed for the proof

key_types.name: AvailReader
key_types.what: finds the submit_data call with the matching content hash in the Ethereum-verified block

key_types.name: HttpObjectReader
key_types.what: mock reader: GET /objects/0x<hash> from a local HTTP server

read_first.why: crate purpose and the trust split: receipt on chain, re-hash on read
read_first.ref: crates/data-availability/src/lib.rs@7@Content-addressed data-availability transport used by Interfold applications.

read_first.why: the retrieval boundary that the e3-evm coordinator calls
the hash check that every reader runs before it returns bytes
publish path: submit, wait for finality, return the coordinates

rust_patterns.note: async trait with Send and Sync bounds; the Avail reader and the HTTP mock reader implement it
the HTTP reader's retrieve() re-hashes the bytes before it returns them
size and emptiness are checked before the bytes are hashed
a bad bridge URL reports a human-readable context
DataReference derives serde, so it can be serialized
rust_patterns.ref: crates/data-availability/src/lib.rs@27@#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]

rust_patterns.note: the re-hash rule is tested offline: matching bytes pass, substituted bytes fail
